conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Aditya Singh. Mera car loan ka EMI schedule kahan se milega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Aditya ji, main aapki madad karoonga. Kya aap apna loan account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine check kiya. Aapka EMI schedule net banking se download ho sakta hai, ya main aapko email kar sakta hoon. Kaunsa option chahenge?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, main schedule aapke registered email pe bhej deta hoon. Koi aur sawal?
